review_method: Executed Lean --deps on every active root Lean source with imported local objects selected only when their adjacent source hash matches the frozen source. A Lean-aware nested-comment/string scanner identifies non-comment nonblank physical lines; reviewed top-level declaration boundaries assign one primary role per line. Operational guards are model; independent algebraic domains and canonical claims are specification. Unchanged automatic aesop wrappers are specification. Newly authored proof modules used by multiple cases are shared helpers, counted once with complete assisted/build use lists. Single-case proof construction and target theorem applications are guidance. Imported upstream libraries, infrastructure, witnesses, negative controls, selection evidence and identical frozen snapshots are inventoried separately, not added to new proof/model LOC. Source counts use whole compiled module closures, not an inferred minimal theorem-term dependency slice. AI-authored text is authored guidance, not compiler-generated source; generated_loc is observed zero.

manual_review.scope: All source-bearing root Lean declarations; operational versus formal-specification boundaries; actual module import case/stage closures; duplicate snapshots and acceptance exclusions.
manual_review.mixed_role_policy: One primary role per physical line; runtime guards and decidability code counted as model, even when also mentioned by specifications. Proof helper statements and their proofs counted together as assistance.

matched_local_objects.selection: Existing actual compiled object; adjacent source byte-identical to current source.
